title: Envelope Sound Picks
heading: The Envelope: pick the music and the voice
intro: Your rules: the Suno track is music and sounds only; the line is an AI Studio voice. Pick one track and one voice (and note anything). Round 1's speaking tracks are folded away below.

sections.lede: Four instrumental sounds, two takes each (open in Suno); four voices for the line, playing here.
